MASTER CYLINDER ASSEMBLY AND BRAKE BOOSTER
TSB Revision
BASIC BRAKE SYSTEM
35A-33
INSTALLATION SERVICE POINTS
>>A<< VACUUM HOSE CONNECTION
1. Install the vacuum hose with the white-marked sections 
facing up.
2. Insert securely and completely until the vacuum hose at the 
engine side contacts the edge of the hexagonal part of the 
fitting, and then secure with the hose clamp.
>>B<< CLEARANCE ADJUSTMENT BETWEEN BRAKE 
BOOSTER PUSHROD AND PRIMARY PISTON
1. Using a hand vacuum pump, apply a negative pressure of −
66.7 kPa (19.6 inHg) to the brake booster.
2. Measure protruding length A at the pushrod.
Standard value (A): 10.28 − 10.53 mm (0.404 − 0.415 
inch)
3. If the protruding length is not within the standard value 
range, adjust by changing the pushrod length by turning the 
end of the pushrod.
